entry.title: The Surrey (Structural Changes) (Pensions etc.) Order 2026
entry.summary: This Order gives effect to proposals made by Surrey County Council, in its capacity as the administering authority of the Surrey Pension Fund and in the context of the local government reorganisation brought about by the Surrey (Structural Changes) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/264), for the transfer of its pensions functions to a new body, the Surrey Pensions Authority.

entry.title: The Local Government (Structural and Boundary Changes) (Control of Disposals etc.) (Amendment) Order 2026

ukm:Supersedes.dc:title: The Local Government (Structural and Boundary Changes) (Control of Disposals etc.) (Amendment) Order 2026

entry.summary: This Order amends a provision in the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 (c. 28) (“the 2007 Act”) relating to the control of property disposals and contractual dealings that local authorities that are to be dissolved pursuant to an Order made under section 7 (implementation of proposals by order) or section 10 (implementation of recommendations by order) of the 2007 Act may make or enter into without the consent of specified persons.

entry.title: The Local Government (Structural Changes) (Finance) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
entry.summary: Part 1 of the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 (”the 2007 Act”) provides for structural and boundary changes in relation to local government areas in England. The Local Government (Structural Changes) (Finance) Regulations 2008 (“the 2008 Regulations”) made under section 14 and 240(1) of the 2007 Act make supplementary provision of general application in relation to the exercise of certain functions for the purposes of, and in consequence of, orders made by the Secretary of State under section 7 and section 10 of the 2007 Act (“section 7 orders” or “section 10 orders”).

entry.title: The Surrey (Structural Changes) Order 2026
entry.summary: This Order provides for the establishment, on 1st April 2027, of a single tier of local government in Surrey. Part 2 creates two new councils: West Surrey Council, for the same area as the existing districts of Guildford, Runnymede, Spelthorne, Surrey Heath, Waverley and Woking; and East Surrey Council, for the same area as the existing districts of Elmbridge, Epsom and Ewell, Mole Valley, Reigate and Banstead and Tandridge.
